methodologyNotes: Covers aftermarket car audio subwoofer drivers and loaded/powered subwoofer enclosures sold at a published US price for in-vehicle installation. Excludes home theater subwoofers, full-range car speakers, and OEM factory subs. Price is typical US MSRP or common street price in USD. coneSizeIn is the nominal driver diameter in inches. rmsPowerWatts is manufacturer-rated continuous (RMS) power handling in watts. peakPowerWatts is manufacturer-rated peak/max power handling in watts. impedanceOhms is nominal impedance per voice coil in ohms. voiceCoilConfig is an enum: single-voice-coil or dual-voice-coil. sensitivityDb is rated sensitivity in dB at 1W/1m; null if not disclosed. frequencyResponseHz is the manufacturer usable frequency response range in Hz, written low-high. enclosureType is an enum describing how the model ships: component-driver (raw driver), sealed-enclosure, ported-enclosure, or powered (integrated amplifier). mountingDepthIn is the required installation/mounting depth in inches. xmaxMm is rated linear one-way excursion (Xmax) in mm; null if not disclosed. weightLbs is unit weight in pounds.

products.name: JL Audio 12W7AE-3
products.priceNote: US price $1,449.99 as listed (in stock) on the Classic Car Stereos product page for the JL Audio 12W7AE-3, Item #12W7AE-3 (figure shown verbatim as "$1,449.99"). products.provenance: The Classic Car Stereos product page (source) reproduces JL Audio's official spec table for the exact model 12W7AE-3 (Item #12W7AE-3), confirming it as the 3-ohm, single-voice-coil 12-inch W7 Anniversary Edition driver ("commemorates the 10 year anniversary of the JL Audio W7 3 Ohm 12-inch subwoofer series", "comes in a single, 3 ohm voice coil") and listing a US price of $1,449.99, RMS power 1000W, efficiency 86.2dB @ 1W/1M, mounting depth 9.5" (241mm), and net weight 45 lb. The Loudspeaker Database entry (corroboration) independently confirms the same 12" 3Ω driver and supplies the rated one-way linear excursion of 29 mm (x max) plus matching 1000 W power and 241 mm mounting depth. JL Audio's own live product pages now redirect to a JS-rendered Garmin storefront and the official spec sheet is a scanned/binary PDF, neither of which yields machine-readable verbatim text via fetch-clean, so the retailer page reproducing JL Audio's spec sheet was used as the primary readable source.
